description: This source file defines interfaces, extension methods, and classes for configuring EventHub streams within the Orleans hosting framework. It includes configurator interfaces for both silo and cluster client contexts, along with extension methods to facilitate configuration setup, such as data adapters, checkpointers, partition receiver, and cache pressure options.

classes.name: SiloEventHubStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up EventHub streaming on an Orleans silo, allowing configuration of options, checkpointers, partition receiver, and cache pressure.

classes.name: ClusterClientEventHubStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up EventHub streaming on an Orleans cluster client, including service configuration and option validation.

methods.name: ConfigureEventHub
methods.description: Extension method to configure EventHub options.

methods.name: UseDataAdapter
methods.description: Extension method to set the data adapter factory for EventHub streams.

methods.name: ConfigureCheckpointer
methods.description: Configures a checkpointer for SiloEventHubStream using a factory method and options action.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitionReceiver
methods.description: Configures the partition receiver options for SiloEventHubStream.

methods.name: ConfigureCachePressuring
methods.description: Configures cache pressure options for SiloEventHubStream.

methods.name: UseAzureTableCheckpointer
methods.description: Sets up Azure Table checkpointer options for SiloEventHubStream.

methods.name: ClusterClientEventHubStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Configures EventHub streaming for an Orleans cluster client with options validation.
